sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller=function($sce) {
  var c = this;

  // ── PAGE IDs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  var PAGE_IDS = {
    home:           'test_catalog',
    myAppointments: 'my_appointments'
  };

  c.loading         = false;
  c.searchQuery     = '';
  c.sortBy          = 'date_desc';
  c.filteredReports = [];
  c.showModal       = false;
  c.selectedReport  = null;

  c.stats = [
    { icon: ']]>📄<![CDATA[', label: 'Total Reports',  count: 0 },
    { icon: '✅', label: 'Ready',           count: 0 },
    { icon: '⏳', label: 'Pending',         count: 0 },
    { icon: ']]>🔬<![CDATA[', label: 'Tests Completed', count: 0 }
  ];

  // ── TRUST HTML FINDINGS ───────────────────────────────────
  // Converts raw HTML string in findings to trusted HTML so
  // ng-bind-html renders the formatted table instead of plain text
  var trustFindings = function(reports) {
    reports.forEach(function(r) {
      if (r.findings && typeof r.findings === 'string') {
        r.findings = $sce.trustAsHtml(r.findings);
      }
    });
  };

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  var _nav = function(pageId) {
    var portalId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] || 'sp';
    window.location.href = '/' + portalId + '?id=' + pageId;
  };

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.$onInit = function() {
    c.buildStats();
    c.filterReports();
  };

  c.buildStats = function() {
    var rpts = c.data.reports || [];
    c.stats[0].count = rpts.length;
    c.stats[1].count = rpts.filter(function(r) { return r.status === 'ready'; }).length;
    c.stats[2].count = rpts.filter(function(r) { return r.status === 'pending'; }).length;
    c.stats[3].count = rpts.filter(function(r) {
      return r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'ready';
    }).length;
  };

  c.filterReports = function() {
    var all = angular.copy(c.data.reports || []);
    var q   = (c.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase();

    c.filteredReports = all.filter(function(r) {
      return !q ||
        (r.test_name     && r.test_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)     !== -1) ||
        (r.report_number && r.report_number.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
        (r.doctor_name   && r.doctor_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)   !== -1);
    });

    c.filteredReports.sort(function(a, b) {
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_asc')  return (a.report_date || '').localeCompare(b.report_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_desc') return (b.report_date || '').localeCompare(a.report_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'name')      return (a.test_name   || '').localeCompare(b.test_name   || '');
      return 0;
    });

    // ★ Trust HTML findings for all filtered reports so ng-bind-html renders properly
    trustFindings(c.filteredReports);
  };

  // ── STATUS HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────
  var RPT_STATUS = {
    'ready':      { color: '#10b981', bg: '#dcfce7', label: '✅ Ready'      },
    'completed':  { color: '#10b981', bg: '#dcfce7', label: '✅ Completed'  },
    'pending':    { color: '#f59e0b', bg: '#fef3c7', label: '⏳ Pending'    },
    'processing': { color: '#3b82f6', bg: '#dbeafe', label: ']]>🔬<![CDATA[ Processing' }
  };

  var _rptProp = function(s, prop, fallback) {
    return (RPT_STATUS[s] && RPT_STATUS[s][prop]) ? RPT_STATUS[s][prop] : fallback;
  };

  c.getStatusColor = function(s) { return _rptProp(s, 'color', '#94a3b8'); };
  c.getStatusBg    = function(s) { return _rptProp(s, 'bg',    '#f1f5f9'); };
  c.getStatusLabel = function(s) { return _rptProp(s, 'label', s || 'Ready'); };

  c.getCategoryIcon = function(cat) {
    var icons = {
      'blood':      ']]>🩸<![CDATA[',
      'urine':      ']]>🧪<![CDATA[',
      'imaging':    ']]>🩻<![CDATA[',
      'radiology':  ']]>🩻<![CDATA[',
      'cardiology': '❤️',
      'neurology':  ']]>🧠<![CDATA[',
      'genetics':   ']]>🧬<![CDATA[',
      'pathology':  ']]>🔬<![CDATA['
    };
    if (!cat) return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
    var k = cat.toLowerCase();
    for (var key in icons) { if (k.indexOf(key) !== -1) return icons[key]; }
    return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
  };

  // ── MODAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.viewDetail = function(report) {
    // Use angular.copy so modal has its own independent copy
    c.selectedReport = angular.copy(report);

    // ★ Trust HTML findings for the modal view
    if (c.selectedReport.findings && typeof c.selectedReport.findings === 'string') {
      c.selectedReport.findings = $sce.trustAsHtml(c.selectedReport.findings);
    }

    c.showModal = true;
  };

  c.closeModal = function() {
    c.showModal      = false;
    c.selectedReport = null;
  };

  c.downloadReport = function(report) {
    if (report && report.report_url) {
      window.open(report.report_url, '_blank');
    } else {
      alert('Report file is not yet available for download.');
    }
  };

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.goHome     = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.home); };
  c.goBookings = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.myAppointments); };
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.lab-reports {
  --primary: #0a2463;
  --accent: #00b4d8;
  --success: #10b981;
  --warning: #f59e0b;
  --danger: #ef4444;
  --info: #3b82f6;
  --gray-50: #f8fafc;
  --gray-100: #f1f5f9;
  --gray-200: #e2e8f0;
  --gray-400: #94a3b8;
  --gray-600: #475569;
  --gray-800: #1e293b;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.09);
  --radius: 14px;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: var(--gray-50);
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 0 0 60px;
}

/* HEADER */
.rpt-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #1e3a8a 100%);
  padding: 40px 40px 50px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-radius: 0 0 32px 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
}
.rpt-title { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.rpt-sub   { color: #bfdbfe; margin: 0; font-size: 15px; }
.rpt-header-right { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; }

.btn-back-home, .btn-my-bookings {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-back-home {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}
.btn-back-home:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
.btn-my-bookings {
  background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,180,216,0.35);
}
.btn-my-bookings:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

/* STATS BAR */
.rpt-stats-bar { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 24px 40px 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rpt-stat-card {
  flex: 1; min-width: 120px; background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  padding: 16px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.rpt-stat-icon { font-size: 28px; }
.rpt-stat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.rpt-stat-val  { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); line-height: 1; }
.rpt-stat-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-top: 2px; }

/* CONTROLS */
.rpt-controls {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 20px 40px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.rpt-search-wrap {
  position: relative; flex: 1; max-width: 400px;
}
.rpt-search-wrap .fa {
  position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--gray-400);
}
.rpt-search {
  padding: 10px 14px 10px 36px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s; box-sizing: border-box;
}
.rpt-search:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
.rpt-sort {
  padding: 10px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; background: var(--white);
  cursor: pointer; outline: none;
}
.rpt-sort:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

/* LOADING */
.rpt-loading { text-align: center; padding: 60px; color: var(--gray-600); }
.spinner-ring {
  display: inline-block; width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border: 4px solid var(--gray-200); border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* EMPTY */
.rpt-empty { text-align: center; padding: 60px 40px; }
.rpt-empty-icon { font-size: 56px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.rpt-empty h3 { font-size: 20px; color: var(--gray-800); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.rpt-empty p  { color: var(--gray-600); margin: 0 0 20px; }
.btn-book-test {
  padding: 12px 28px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff;
  border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s;
}
.btn-book-test:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }

/* REPORTS LIST */
.rpt-list { padding: 8px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }

/* REPORT CARD */
.rpt-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); display: flex; overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
}
.rpt-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.rpt-card-accent { width: 5px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.rpt-card-content { flex: 1; padding: 20px 24px; }

/* TOP ROW */
.rpt-card-top {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.rpt-card-title-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.rpt-icon { font-size: 32px; }
.rpt-test-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gray-800); margin: 0 0 4px; }
.rpt-number { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; }
.rpt-status-wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.rpt-status-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
}

/* META */
.rpt-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.rpt-meta-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); background: var(--gray-100);
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px;
}
.rpt-meta-chip .fa { color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; }

/* FINDINGS — container */
.rpt-findings {
  background: #f0f9ff;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.rpt-findings-label {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Rich HTML body inside findings (card view) */
.rpt-findings-body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-800); }

.rpt-findings-body h3 {
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary);
  margin: 0 0 10px; padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
}
.rpt-findings-body p { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); }
.rpt-findings-body strong { color: var(--gray-800); }

/* Table inside findings */
.rpt-findings-body table,
.rpt-modal-findings table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.rpt-findings-body table thead tr,
.rpt-modal-findings table thead tr {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
}
.rpt-findings-body table th,
.rpt-modal-findings table th {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  border: none;
}
.rpt-findings-body table td,
.rpt-modal-findings table td {
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  color: var(--gray-800);
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.rpt-findings-body table tbody tr:last-child td,
.rpt-modal-findings table tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.rpt-findings-body table tbody tr:nth-child(even),
.rpt-modal-findings table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--gray-50);
}
.rpt-findings-body table tbody tr:hover,
.rpt-modal-findings table tbody tr:hover {
  background: #e0f2fe;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

/* Status text colours inside findings table (Normal / Abnormal) */
.rpt-findings-body td:last-child,
.rpt-modal-findings td:last-child {
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* REMARKS */
.rpt-remarks {
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); background: var(--gray-50);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gray-200); padding: 6px 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
}

/* ACTIONS */
.rpt-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rpt-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer; border: none; transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-view-detail { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
.btn-view-detail:hover { background: #bfdbfe; }
.btn-download { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.btn-download:hover { background: #bbf7d0; }
.btn-close-modal { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.btn-close-modal:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }
.rpt-appt-link { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--gray-400); }

/* MODAL */
.rpt-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  z-index: 9999; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; padding: 20px;
}
.rpt-modal-box {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: 20px;
  max-width: 680px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease;
  max-height: 90vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
@keyframes slideUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.rpt-modal-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.rpt-modal-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.rpt-modal-close {
  background: none; border: none; color: #fff;
  font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.8;
}
.rpt-modal-close:hover { opacity: 1; }
.rpt-modal-body { padding: 24px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
.rpt-modal-footer {
  padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Rich HTML findings inside modal */
.rpt-modal-findings {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-800);
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.rpt-modal-findings h3 {
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary);
  margin: 0 0 10px; padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
}
.rpt-modal-findings p { margin: 8px 0; color: var(--gray-600); }

/* DETAIL GRID */
.rpt-detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
.rpt-detail-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.rpt-detail-item.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.rpt-detail-key {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gray-400); letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
.rpt-detail-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-800); }
.rpt-detail-val.mono { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--primary); }

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .rpt-header, .rpt-stats-bar, .rpt-controls, .rpt-list {
    padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px;
  }
  .rpt-card-top { flex-direction: column; }
  .rpt-detail-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .rpt-modal-box { max-width: 100%; }
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Widget to display and manage functionalities</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>lab_reports</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>Lab Reports</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
  data.reports = [];

  try {
    var userID    = gs.getUserID();
    var userEmail = gs.getUser().getEmail() || '';

    // ── STEP 1: Collect ALL patient sys_ids for this user ─────────────

    var patientMap    = {};
    var patientSysIds = [];

    // A) By user reference field on patient table
    var p1 = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_patient');
    p1.addQuery('user', userID);
    p1.query();
    while (p1.next()) {
      var pid1 = p1.getUniqueValue();
      if (!patientMap[pid1]) { patientMap[pid1] = true; patientSysIds.push(pid1); }
    }

    // B) By email match
    if (userEmail) {
      var p2 = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_patient');
      p2.addQuery('email', userEmail);
      p2.query();
      while (p2.next()) {
        var pid2 = p2.getUniqueValue();
        if (!patientMap[pid2]) { patientMap[pid2] = true; patientSysIds.push(pid2); }
      }
    }

    // C) Find patients via appointments created by this user
    var a1 = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
    a1.addQuery('created_by', userID);
    a1.query();
    while (a1.next()) {
      var pRef = a1.getValue('patient');
      if (pRef && !patientMap[pRef]) {
        patientMap[pRef] = true;
        patientSysIds.push(pRef);
      }
    }

    if (patientSysIds.length === 0) {
      data.reports = [];
      return;
    }

    // ── STEP 2: Query reports by patient field ────────────────────────

    var reportGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_report_table');
    reportGr.addQuery('patient', 'IN', patientSysIds.join(','));
    reportGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    reportGr.query();

    while (reportGr.next()) {

      // Get appointment details — number, test name, category, test date
      var testName        = '';
      var testCategory    = '';
      var apptNum         = '';
      var testDateRaw     = '';
      var testDateDisplay = '';
      var apptRef         = reportGr.getValue('appointment');

      if (apptRef) {
        var apptGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
        if (apptGr.get(apptRef)) {
          apptNum = apptGr.getValue('appointment_number') || '';

          // Try common date field names on appointment table
         var rawApptDate = '';

if (apptGr.getValue('appointment_date')) {
    rawApptDate = apptGr.getValue('appointment_date');
}

if (!rawApptDate && apptGr.getValue('scheduled_date')) {
    rawApptDate = apptGr.getValue('scheduled_date');
}

if (!rawApptDate && apptGr.getValue('test_date')) {
    rawApptDate = apptGr.getValue('test_date');
}

if (!rawApptDate && apptGr.getValue('date')) {
    rawApptDate = apptGr.getValue('date');
}

          if (rawApptDate) {
            testDateRaw = rawApptDate;
            try {
              testDateDisplay = new GlideDateTime(rawApptDate).getLocalDate().getValue();
            } catch(de) {
              testDateDisplay = rawApptDate.split(' ')[0] || rawApptDate;
            }
          }

          // Test name and category from linked diagnostic test
          var testRef = apptGr.getValue('test');
          if (testRef) {
            var testGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_diagnostic_test');
            if (testGr.get(testRef)) {
              testName     = testGr.getValue('test_name') || '';
              testCategory = testGr.getDisplayValue('category') || testGr.getValue('category') || '';
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Verified by / doctor name
      var doctorName  = '';
      var verifiedRef = reportGr.getValue('verified_by');
      if (verifiedRef) {
        var docGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (docGr.get(verifiedRef)) {
          doctorName = docGr.getDisplayValue('name') || '';
        }
      }

      // Format report date
      var reportDateRaw     = reportGr.getValue('report_date') || '';
      var reportDateDisplay = '';
      if (reportDateRaw) {
        try {
          reportDateDisplay = new GlideDateTime(reportDateRaw).getLocalDate().getValue();
        } catch(de) {
          reportDateDisplay = reportDateRaw.split(' ')[0] || reportDateRaw;
        }
      }

      // Status
      var rptStatus = 'ready';
      try {
        var sv = reportGr.getValue('status');
        if (sv) rptStatus = sv;
      } catch(se) { /* field doesn't exist, use default */ }

      // Findings — preserve full HTML for rich table display
      var findingsHTML = '';
      try {
        findingsHTML = reportGr.getHTMLValue('findings') || '';
      } catch(fe) {
        findingsHTML = reportGr.getValue('findings') || '';
      }

      data.reports.push({
        sys_id:              reportGr.getUniqueValue(),
        report_number:       reportGr.getValue('number') || '',
        status:              rptStatus,
        findings:            findingsHTML,
        test_date:           testDateRaw,
        test_date_display:   testDateDisplay,
        report_date:         reportDateRaw,
        report_date_display: reportDateDisplay,
        doctor_name:         doctorName,
        report_url:          '',
        test_name:           testName || ('Report ' + (reportGr.getValue('number') || '')),
        test_category:       testCategory,
        appointment_number:  apptNum
      });
    }

  } catch(e) {
    gs.error('Lab Reports Widget Error: ' + e.message);
    data.error   = e.message;
    data.reports = [];
  }

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 17:05:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>7b9383f1470f47d0a17cd369316d435e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>14</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Lab Reports</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center" source="x_1955191_medica_0">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_7b9383f1470f47d0a17cd369316d435e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 10:50:12</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="lab-reports">

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <div class="rpt-header">
    <div class="rpt-header-left">
      <h1 class="rpt-title">]]>📄<![CDATA[ My Lab Reports</h1>
      <p class="rpt-sub">View and download your diagnostic test results.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="rpt-header-right">
      <button class="btn-back-home" ng-click="c.goHome()">
        <i class="fa fa-home"></i> Home
      </button>
      <button class="btn-my-bookings" ng-click="c.goBookings()">
        <i class="fa fa-calendar"></i> My Bookings
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATS BAR -->
  <div class="rpt-stats-bar">
    <div class="rpt-stat-card" ng-repeat="stat in c.stats">
      <span class="rpt-stat-icon">{{stat.icon}}</span>
      <div class="rpt-stat-info">
        <span class="rpt-stat-val">{{stat.count}}</span>
        <span class="rpt-stat-name">{{stat.label}}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SEARCH -->
  <div class="rpt-controls">
    <div class="rpt-search-wrap">
      <i class="fa fa-search"></i>
      <input type="text" class="rpt-search" placeholder="Search by test name or report number..."
        ng-model="c.searchQuery" ng-change="c.filterReports()" />
    </div>
    <select class="rpt-sort" ng-model="c.sortBy" ng-change="c.filterReports()">
      <option value="date_desc">Newest First</option>
      <option value="date_asc">Oldest First</option>
      <option value="name">By Test Name</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <!-- LOADING -->
  <div class="rpt-loading" ng-if="c.loading">
    <div class="spinner-ring"></div>
    <p>Loading your reports...</p>
  </div>

  <!-- EMPTY STATE -->
  <div class="rpt-empty" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredReports.length === 0">
    <div class="rpt-empty-icon">]]>📭<![CDATA[</div>
    <h3>No reports found</h3>
    <p ng-if="c.searchQuery">No reports match your search.</p>
    <p ng-if="!c.searchQuery">Your lab reports will appear here once they are uploaded by the diagnostic center.</p>
    <button class="btn-book-test" ng-click="c.goHome()">Browse Tests</button>
  </div>

  <!-- REPORTS LIST -->
  <div class="rpt-list" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredReports.length > 0">
    <div class="rpt-card" ng-repeat="report in c.filteredReports">

      <!-- STATUS BAR -->
      <div class="rpt-card-accent" ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusColor(report.status)}"></div>

      <div class="rpt-card-content">
        <!-- TOP ROW -->
        <div class="rpt-card-top">
          <div class="rpt-card-title-group">
            <span class="rpt-icon">{{c.getCategoryIcon(report.test_category)}}</span>
            <div>
              <h3 class="rpt-test-name" ng-bind="report.test_name"></h3>
              <span class="rpt-number" ng-bind="report.report_number"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-status-wrap">
            <span class="rpt-status-pill"
              ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(report.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(report.status)}">
              {{c.getStatusLabel(report.status)}}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- META -->
        <div class="rpt-meta">
          <div class="rpt-meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-calendar"></i>
            <span>Test Date: {{report.test_date_display || 'N/A'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>
            <span>Report Date: {{report.report_date_display || 'N/A'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-meta-chip" ng-if="report.doctor_name">
            <i class="fa fa-user-md"></i>
            <span>Dr. {{report.doctor_name}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-meta-chip" ng-if="report.test_category">
            <i class="fa fa-tag"></i>
            <span>{{report.test_category}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SUMMARY / FINDINGS — rendered as rich HTML -->
        <div class="rpt-findings" ng-if="report.findings">
          <div class="rpt-findings-label"><i class="fa fa-file-text-o"></i> Findings</div>
          <div class="rpt-findings-body" ng-bind-html="report.findings"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- REMARKS -->
        <div class="rpt-remarks" ng-if="report.remarks">
          <i class="fa fa-comment-o"></i> <em ng-bind="report.remarks"></em>
        </div>

        <!-- ACTIONS -->
        <div class="rpt-actions">
          <button class="rpt-btn btn-view-detail" ng-click="c.viewDetail(report)">
            <i class="fa fa-eye"></i> View Details
          </button>
          <button class="rpt-btn btn-download" ng-if="report.report_url" ng-click="c.downloadReport(report)">
            <i class="fa fa-download"></i> Download Report
          </button>
          <span class="rpt-appt-link" ng-if="report.appointment_number">
            Booking: <strong ng-bind="report.appointment_number"></strong>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DETAIL MODAL -->
  <div class="rpt-modal-overlay" ng-if="c.showModal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">
    <div class="rpt-modal-box" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="rpt-modal-header">
        <h3>Report Details</h3>
        <button class="rpt-modal-close" ng-click="c.closeModal()">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="rpt-modal-body" ng-if="c.selectedReport">
        <div class="rpt-detail-grid">
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Report #</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val mono" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.report_number"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Status</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val">
              <span class="rpt-status-pill"
                ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(c.selectedReport.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(c.selectedReport.status)}">
                {{c.getStatusLabel(c.selectedReport.status)}}
              </span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Test Name</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.test_name"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Category</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.test_category"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Test Date</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.test_date_display"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Report Date</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.report_date_display"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Doctor</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.doctor_name || 'N/A'"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Appointment #</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val mono" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.appointment_number || 'N/A'"></span>
          </div>
          <!-- Findings rendered as rich HTML in modal -->
          <div class="rpt-detail-item full">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Findings</span>
            <div class="rpt-modal-findings" ng-if="c.selectedReport.findings" ng-bind-html="c.selectedReport.findings"></div>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-if="!c.selectedReport.findings">None</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rpt-detail-item full">
            <span class="rpt-detail-key">Remarks</span>
            <span class="rpt-detail-val" ng-bind="c.selectedReport.remarks || 'None'"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="rpt-modal-footer">
        <button class="rpt-btn btn-download"
          ng-if="c.selectedReport && c.selectedReport.report_url"
          ng-click="c.downloadReport(c.selectedReport)">
          <i class="fa fa-download"></i> Download Report
        </button>
        <button class="rpt-btn btn-close-modal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller =function() {
  var c = this;

  // ── PAGE IDs (confirmed from your ServiceNow Pages list) ──
  var PAGE_IDS = {
    home:       'test_catalog',   // ← CORRECT page ID from your screenshot
    labReports: 'lab_reports'
  };

  c.loading = true;
  c.activeTab = 'all';
  c.searchQuery = '';
  c.sortBy = 'date_desc';
  c.filteredAppointments = [];
  c.showModal = false;
  c.selectedAppt = null;

  c.tabs = [
    { key: 'all',       label: 'All',       count: 0 },
    { key: 'pending',   label: 'Pending',   count: 0 },
    { key: 'confirmed', label: 'Confirmed', count: 0 },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Completed', count: 0 },
    { key: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled', count: 0 }
  ];

  c.stats = [
    { icon: ']]>📋<![CDATA[', label: 'Total',     count: 0 },
    { icon: '✅', label: 'Confirmed', count: 0 },
    { icon: '⏳', label: 'Pending',   count: 0 },
    { icon: '✔️', label: 'Completed', count: 0 }
  ];

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  var _nav = function(pageId) {
    var portalId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] || 'sp';
    window.location.href = '/' + portalId + '?id=' + pageId;
  };

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY FIX: ServiceNow populates c.data synchronously BEFORE this runs.
  // $watch('data') never fires. Just read data directly in $onInit.
  c.$onInit = function() {
    c.loading = false;
    c.buildStats();
    c.filterAppointments();
  };

  c.buildStats = function() {
    var appts = c.data.appointments || [];
    c.stats[0].count = appts.length;
    c.stats[1].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'confirmed'; }).length;
    c.stats[2].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'pending';   }).length;
    c.stats[3].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'completed'; }).length;
    c.tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
      tab.count = (tab.key === 'all')
        ? appts.length
        : appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === tab.key; }).length;
    });
  };

  c.setTab = function(key) { c.activeTab = key; c.filterAppointments(); };

  c.filterAppointments = function() {
    var appts = angular.copy(c.data.appointments || []);
    var q   = (c.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase();
    var tab = c.activeTab;
    c.filteredAppointments = appts.filter(function(a) {
      var matchTab    = (tab === 'all') || (a.status === tab);
      var matchSearch = !q ||
        (a.test_name          && a.test_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
        (a.appointment_number && a.appointment_number.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
        (a.test_category      && a.test_category.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1);
      return matchTab && matchSearch;
    });
    c.sortAppointments();
  };

  c.sortAppointments = function() {
    c.filteredAppointments.sort(function(a, b) {
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_asc')  return (a.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(b.scheduled_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_desc') return (b.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(a.scheduled_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'status')    return (a.status || '').localeCompare(b.status || '');
      return 0;
    });
  };

  // ── STATUS HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────
  var STATUS_MAP = {
    'pending':   { color:'#f59e0b', bg:'#fef3c7', icon:'⏳', label:'Pending'   },
    'confirmed': { color:'#3b82f6', bg:'#dbeafe', icon:'✅', label:'Confirmed' },
    'completed': { color:'#10b981', bg:'#dcfce7', icon:'✔️', label:'Completed' },
    'cancelled': { color:'#6b7280', bg:'#f1f5f9', icon:']]>🚫<![CDATA[', label:'Cancelled' },
    'rejected':  { color:'#ef4444', bg:'#fee2e2', icon:'❌', label:'Rejected'  }
  };
  var _statusProp = function(s, prop, fallback) {
    return (STATUS_MAP[s] && STATUS_MAP[s][prop]) ? STATUS_MAP[s][prop] : fallback;
  };
  c.getStatusColor = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'color', '#94a3b8'); };
  c.getStatusBg    = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'bg',    '#f1f5f9'); };
  c.getStatusIcon  = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'icon',  '•');       };
  c.getStatusLabel = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'label', s);         };

  c.getApprovalLabel = function(s) {
    var m = { 'requested':'Approval Requested','approved':'✅ Approved','rejected':'❌ Rejected' };
    return m[s] || s;
  };
  c.getPaymentLabel = function(s) {
    var m = { 'paid':'✓ Paid','pending':'Payment Pending','unpaid':'Unpaid','refunded':'Refunded' };
    return m[s] || (s || 'N/A');
  };
  c.getCategoryIcon = function(cat) {
    var icons = { 'blood':']]>🩸<![CDATA[','urine':']]>🧪<![CDATA[','imaging':']]>🩻<![CDATA[','cardiology':'❤️',
                  'neurology':']]>🧠<![CDATA[','genetics':']]>🧬<![CDATA[','pathology':']]>🔬<![CDATA[' };
    if (!cat) return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';

}]]></link><name>My Appointments</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
  data.appointments = [];

  try {
    var currentUser  = gs.getUser();
    var userID       = gs.getUserID();
    var userEmail    = currentUser.getEmail() || '';
    var userName     = gs.getUserName() || '';

    // ── APPROACH 1: Find patient records linked to this sys_user ──────
    var patientSysIds = [];
    var patientMap    = {};  // sys_id → true (dedup)

    // By user reference field
    var patGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_patient');
    patGr.addQuery('user', userID);
    patGr.query();
    while (patGr.next()) {
      var pid = patGr.getUniqueValue();
      if (!patientMap[pid]) { patientMap[pid] = true; patientSysIds.push(pid); }
    }

    // By email (catches cases where email in form ≠ ServiceNow user email)
    if (userEmail) {
      var patEmailGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_patient');
      patEmailGr.addQuery('email', userEmail);
      patEmailGr.query();
      while (patEmailGr.next()) {
        var eid = patEmailGr.getUniqueValue();
        if (!patientMap[eid]) { patientMap[eid] = true; patientSysIds.push(eid); }
      }
    }

    // ── APPROACH 2: Find appointments created_by this user ────────────
    // KEY FIX: catches bookings where patient email ≠ logged-in user email
    var apptSysIds   = [];
    var apptMap      = {};  // dedup
    var apptDataMap  = {};  // sys_id → raw appointment GlideRecord data

    var createdByGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
    createdByGr.addQuery('created_by', userID);
    createdByGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    createdByGr.query();
    while (createdByGr.next()) {
      var aid = createdByGr.getUniqueValue();
      if (!apptMap[aid]) {
        apptMap[aid] = true;
        apptSysIds.push(aid);

        // Also collect patient IDs from these appointments
        var pRef = createdByGr.getValue('patient');
        if (pRef && !patientMap[pRef]) {
          patientMap[pRef] = true;
          patientSysIds.push(pRef);
        }
      }
    }

    // ── APPROACH 3: Appointments linked to any patient record found ────
    if (patientSysIds.length > 0) {
      var apptPatGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
      apptPatGr.addQuery('patient', 'IN', patientSysIds.join(','));
      apptPatGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
      apptPatGr.query();
      while (apptPatGr.next()) {
        var apid = apptPatGr.getUniqueValue();
        if (!apptMap[apid]) {
          apptMap[apid] = true;
          apptSysIds.push(apid);
        }
      }
    }

    if (apptSysIds.length === 0) {
      data.appointments = [];
      return;
    }

    // ── FETCH FULL APPOINTMENT DATA ────────────────────────────────────
    var finalGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
    finalGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', apptSysIds.join(','));
    finalGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    finalGr.query();

    while (finalGr.next()) {

      // Get test details
      var testName     = '';
      var testCategory = '';
      var testRef      = finalGr.getValue('test');
      if (testRef) {
        var testGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_diagnostic_test');
        if (testGr.get(testRef)) {
          testName     = testGr.getValue('test_name') || '';
          testCategory = testGr.getDisplayValue('category') || testGr.getValue('category') || '';
        }
      }

      // Check if report exists
      var hasReport = false;
      var reportGr  = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_report_table');
      reportGr.addQuery('appointment', finalGr.getUniqueValue());
      reportGr.setLimit(1);
      reportGr.query();
      if (reportGr.next()) { hasReport = true; }

      // Approved by name
      var approvedByName = '';
      var approvedByRef  = finalGr.getValue('approved_by');
      if (approvedByRef) {
        var approverGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (approverGr.get(approvedByRef)) {
          approvedByName = approverGr.getDisplayValue('name') || '';
        }
      }

      // Format dates safely
      var scheduledRaw = finalGr.getValue('scheduled_date') || '';
      var scheduledDisplay = '';
      if (scheduledRaw) {
        try {
          var gdt = new GlideDateTime(scheduledRaw);
          scheduledDisplay = gdt.getLocalDate().getLocalDate();
        } catch(dateErr) {
          scheduledDisplay = scheduledRaw.split(' ')[0] || scheduledRaw;
        }
      }

      var createdOn = finalGr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || '';

      data.appointments.push({
        sys_id:              finalGr.getUniqueValue(),
        appointment_number:  finalGr.getValue('appointment_number') || '',
        status:              finalGr.getValue('status') || 'pending',
        approval_status:     finalGr.getValue('approval_status') || '',
        payment_status:      finalGr.getValue('payment_status') || '',
        scheduled_date:      scheduledRaw,
        scheduled_date_display: scheduledDisplay,
        slot_time:           finalGr.getValue('slot_time') || '',
        total_amount:        parseFloat(finalGr.getValue('total_amount')) || 0,
        notes:               finalGr.getValue('notes') || '',
        rejection_reason:    finalGr.getValue('rejection_reason') || '',
        confirmation_sent:   finalGr.getValue('confirmation_sent') === '1' || finalGr.getValue('confirmation_sent') === true,
        test_name:           testName,
        test_category:       testCategory,
        approved_by_name:    approvedByName,
        has_report:          hasReport,
        created_on_display:  createdOn
      });
    }

    // ── HANDLE CANCEL ACTION ───────────────────────────────────────────
    if (input && input.action === 'cancel_appointment') {
      var cancelGr = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_appointment_table');
      if (cancelGr.get(input.appointment_sys_id)) {

        // Verify ownership: created_by OR patient belongs to this user
        var isOwner = false;
        if (cancelGr.getValue('created_by') === userID) {
          isOwner = true;
        } else {
          var cancelPatId = cancelGr.getValue('patient');
          if (cancelPatId && patientSysIds.indexOf(cancelPatId) !== -1) {
            isOwner = true;
          }
        }

        if (isOwner) {
          cancelGr.setValue('status', 'cancelled');
          cancelGr.update();
          data.success = true;

          // Send cancellation email
          try {
            var patEmail2 = '';
            var patGr2 = new GlideRecord('x_1955191_medica_0_patient');
            if (patGr2.get(cancelGr.getValue('patient'))) {
              patEmail2 = patGr2.getValue('email') || '';
            }
            if (patEmail2) {
              var emailer = new GlideEmailOutbound();
              emailer.setTo(patEmail2);
              emailer.setSubject('Appointment Cancelled: ' + cancelGr.getValue('appointment_number'));
              emailer.setBody('<p>Your appointment <strong>' +
                cancelGr.getValue('appointment_number') +
                '</strong> has been cancelled. If this was a mistake, please book again.</p>');
              emailer.save();
            }
          } catch(emailErr) {
            gs.warn('Cancel email error: ' + emailErr.message);
          }

        } else {
          data.error = 'Unauthorized';
        }
      } else {
        data.error = 'Appointment not found';
      }
    }

  } catch(e) {
    gs.error('My Appointments Widget Error: ' + e.message);
    data.error = 'Failed to load appointments: ' + e.message;
    data.appointments = [];
  }
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 09:00:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>e7645575474f07d0a17cd369316d43ec</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>My Appointments</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center" source="x_1955191_medica_0">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_e7645575474f07d0a17cd369316d43ec</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 18:20:38</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[


      <div class="my-appts">
<!-- HEADER -->
  <div class="appts-header">
    <div class="header-left">
      <h1 class="header-title">]]>📋<![CDATA[ My Appointments</h1>
      <p class="header-sub">Track all your booked diagnostic tests in one place.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="header-right">
      <button class="btn-book-new" ng-click="c.bookNew()">
        <i class="fa fa-plus"></i> Book New Test
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATS BAR -->
  <div class="stats-bar">
    <div class="stat-card" ng-repeat="stat in c.stats">
      <span class="stat-icon">{{stat.icon}}</span>
      <div class="stat-info">
        <span class="stat-val">{{stat.count}}</span>
        <span class="stat-name">{{stat.label}}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- FILTER TABS -->
  <div class="filter-tabs">
    <button
      class="filter-tab"
      ng-repeat="tab in c.tabs"
      ng-class="{'active': c.activeTab === tab.key}"
      ng-click="c.setTab(tab.key)"
    >
      {{tab.label}}
      <span class="tab-count" ng-if="tab.count > 0">{{tab.count}}</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- SEARCH + SORT -->
  <div class="list-controls">
    <div class="search-mini-wrap">
      <i class="fa fa-search"></i>
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Search appointments..."
        ng-model="c.searchQuery"
        ng-change="c.filterAppointments()"
        class="search-mini"
      />
    </div>
    <select ng-model="c.sortBy" ng-change="c.sortAppointments()" class="sort-mini">
      <option value="date_desc">Newest First</option>
      <option value="date_asc">Oldest First</option>
      <option value="status">By Status</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <!-- LOADING -->
  <div class="loading-center" ng-if="c.loading">
    <div class="spinner-ring"></div>
    <p>Loading your appointments...</p>
  </div>

  <!-- EMPTY STATE -->
  <div class="empty-appts" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredAppointments.length === 0">
    <div class="empty-emoji">]]>📭<![CDATA[</div>
    <h3>No appointments found</h3>
    <p ng-if="c.activeTab !== 'all'">No {{c.activeTab}} appointments yet.</p>
    <p ng-if="c.activeTab === 'all'">You haven't booked any tests yet.</p>
    <button class="btn-book-first" ng-click="c.bookNew()">Book Your First Test</button>
  </div>

  <!-- APPOINTMENTS LIST -->
  <div class="appts-list" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredAppointments.length > 0">
    <div
      class="appt-card"
      ng-repeat="appt in c.filteredAppointments"
      ng-class="'appt-' + appt.status"
    >

      <!-- LEFT ACCENT BAR -->
      <div class="appt-accent-bar" ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusColor(appt.status)}"></div>

      <!-- CARD CONTENT -->
      <div class="appt-content">

        <!-- TOP ROW -->
        <div class="appt-top">
          <div class="appt-title-group">
            <span class="appt-icon">{{c.getCategoryIcon(appt.test_category)}}</span>
            <div>
              <h3 class="appt-test-name">{{appt.test_name}}</h3>
              <span class="appt-number">{{appt.appointment_number}}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="appt-status-wrap">
            <span
              class="status-pill"
              ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(appt.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(appt.status)}"
            >
              {{c.getStatusIcon(appt.status)}} {{c.getStatusLabel(appt.status)}}
            </span>
            <span
              class="approval-pill"
              ng-if="appt.approval_status"
              ng-class="'approval-' + appt.approval_status"
            >
              {{c.getApprovalLabel(appt.approval_status)}}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- META ROW -->
        <div class="appt-meta">
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-calendar"></i>
            <span>{{appt.scheduled_date_display}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>
            <span>{{appt.slot_time || 'N/A'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-tag"></i>
            <span>{{appt.test_category || 'General'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip" ng-if="appt.total_amount">
            <i class="fa fa-dollar"></i>
            <span>${{appt.total_amount | number:2}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- PAYMENT + APPROVAL STATUS -->
        <div class="appt-info-row">
          <div class="info-badge" ng-class="'pay-' + appt.payment_status">
            <i class="fa fa-credit-card"></i>
            Payment: <strong>{{c.getPaymentLabel(appt.payment_status)}}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="info-badge approval-info" ng-if="appt.approved_by_name">
            <i class="fa fa-user-check"></i>
            Approved by: <strong>{{appt.approved_by_name}}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="info-badge conf-badge" ng-if="appt.confirmation_sent">
            <i class="fa fa-envelope-o"></i> Confirmation Sent
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- NOTES -->
        <div class="appt-notes" ng-if="appt.notes">
          <i class="fa fa-sticky-note-o"></i> <em>{{appt.notes}}</em>
        </div>

        <!-- REJECTION REASON -->
        <div class="rejection-banner" ng-if="appt.rejection_reason">
          <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
          <div>
            <strong>Rejection Reason:</strong>
            <span>{{appt.rejection_reason}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ACTIONS -->
        <div class="appt-actions">
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-view"
            ng-click="c.viewDetails(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-eye"></i> View Details
          </button>
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-cancel"
            ng-if="c.canCancel(appt)"
            ng-click="c.cancelAppointment(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-times"></i> Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-report"
            ng-if="appt.has_report"
            ng-click="c.viewReport(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-file-text"></i> View Report
          </button>
          <span class="date-chip">
            Booked: {{appt.created_on_display}}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DETAIL MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" ng-if="c.showModal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">
    <div class="modal-box" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3>Appointment Details</h3>
        <button class="modal-close" ng-click="c.closeModal()">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body" ng-if="c.selectedAppt">
        <div class="detail-grid">
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Appointment #</span>
            <span class="detail-val mono">{{c.selectedAppt.appointment_number}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">
              <span class="status-pill" ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(c.selectedAppt.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(c.selectedAppt.status)}">
                {{c.getStatusLabel(c.selectedAppt.status)}}
              </span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Test</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.test_name}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Category</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.test_category}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Scheduled Date</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.scheduled_date_display}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Time Slot</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.slot_time}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Total Amount</span>
            <span class="detail-val paid-green">${{c.selectedAppt.total_amount | number:2}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Payment Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.getPaymentLabel(c.selectedAppt.payment_status)}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Approval Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.getApprovalLabel(c.selectedAppt.approval_status)}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item full">
            <span class="detail-key">Notes</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.notes || 'None'}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn-close-modal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

    gs.info("REPORT BR: Appointment = " + current.getDisplayValue());
    gs.info("Approval = " + current.getValue("approval_status"));
    gs.info("Status = " + current.getValue("status"));

    if (current.getValue("approval_status") == "Approved" &&
        current.getValue("status") == "Completed") {

        var report = new GlideRecord("x_1955191_medica_0_report_table");
        report.initialize();

        report.setValue("appointment", current.getUniqueValue());

        if (report.isValidField("patient")) {
            report.setValue("patient", current.getValue("patient"));
        }

        if (report.isValidField("report_date")) {
            report.setValue("report_date", gs.nowDateTime());
        }

        report.insert();

        gs.info("REPORT CREATED SUCCESSFULLY");
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 06:44:21</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d215f8b9470b07d0a17cd369316d431f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>19</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto Create Report Appointment Complete</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center" source="x_1955191_medica_0">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center">a8f81031470707d0a17cd369316d43f8</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d215f8b9470b07d0a17cd369316d431f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-07 14:05:53</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d215f8b9470b07d0a17cd369316d431f"/></record_update>
